skill.description: Create throwaway HTML mockups with two or three design variants for comparison.

memory.responsibility: Retain product question plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform shared content model into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through variant a while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Expose only the production and rendering capabilities needed for the requested artifact and format.

stages: Define the single design decision to explore
Build two or three HTML variants
Render at desktop and phone sizes
Keep the selected direction or discard all

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
